operations.details: Verified HMLR PG41 supplement 6 overriding-interest guidance.
Registered interests separated from geometry and elevation evidence.
Multi-plot legal interest does not imply shared parcel geometry.
Verified HMLR Practice Guide 11 official-copy guidance.
Official copies treated as timed registration evidence.
View products not silently promoted to official-copy authority.
Certificate of inspection limited to title/plot identity semantics.
Official-copy status does not create exact surveyed boundary coordinates.
Register/title evidence cannot substitute LiDAR terrain samples.
No fabricated values or ownership inference added.
Child preview only; canonical publisher unchanged.
